blocks.title: Osmoregulation
blocks.text: Osmoregulation is the maintenance of the balance of water and solutes in the body fluids, so that they become neither too dilute nor too concentrated.

It is essential for keeping blood pressure right, for the proper working of organs and for regulating metabolism. Recall that osmosis is the diffusion of water across a membrane from a more dilute (hypotonic) solution to a less dilute (hypertonic) one, and osmotic pressure measures a solution's tendency to take in water by osmosis.

blocks.prompt: In which direction does water move by osmosis?
blocks.explanation: From the more dilute (hypotonic) solution to the more concentrated (hypertonic) solution.

items: Osmoregulation balances water and solutes in body fluids; water moves by osmosis towards the more concentrated side.
